_comment: Benchmark configurations. mods: mod sets from mods.json/mods.lock.json copied into the run's mods/ folder. ingot: value of -Dingot.enabled (Ingot is on the classpath in every configuration). expectBackend: case-insensitive substring the GPU backend name must contain, otherwise the result is marked invalid (catches Ingot silently falling back to OpenGL). rejectBackend: substring it must not contain (catches Ingot running where it should be disabled). options: options.txt lines that override bench/options.base.txt. ingotProps: Ingot settings (config/ingot.properties keys) on top of the defaults in benchlib.ingot_props (Performance mode, full resolution).

vanilla.description: Fabric Loader + bench harness only; Ingot present but disabled

mainstream.description: Performance core of Fabulously Optimized 26.3 (Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, EntityCulling, MoreCulling, ModernFix + required deps); Ingot disabled

ingot.description: Ingot (Metal backend) enabled, no other mods

ingot-battery.description: Ingot in Battery mode: frame cap at the display refresh rate, background workers on the efficiency cores, full resolution

ingot-battery-half.description: Ingot in Battery mode at half resolution (one pixel per point)

ingot-half.description: Ingot in Performance mode at half resolution

ingot-nomerge.description: Ingot (Performance mode) with render pass merging switched off, for the A/B

ingot-g1.description: Ingot (Performance mode) on G1 instead of ZGC, no pre-touched heap

ingot-profile-battery.description: What the Modrinth profile runs on battery: Ingot Battery mode (full resolution) with the profile's G1 JVM flags
